DEVOUT-STRIKE_DEVOUT.title: Strike
DEVOUT-DEFEND_DEVOUT.title: Defend
DEVOUT-PRAY_DEVOUT.title: Pray
DEVOUT-ANGUR.title: Angur
DEVOUT-ANGURVADAL.title: Angurvadal
DEVOUT-ANGEL_BLADE.title: Angel's Blade
DEVOUT-DEMON_FANGS.title: Demon's Fangs
DEVOUT-SWORD_OF_EDEN.title: Sword of Eden
DEVOUT-SWORD_OF_EDEN.description:
Whenever you [gold]Unsheathe[/gold], [gold]Angur[/gold] is transformed into [gold]Angurvadal[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:|
At the start of each turn, add {Cards:diff()} [gold]{Cards:plural:Burn|Burns}[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].}
DEVOUT-SHADOW_EMBRACE.title: Shadow's Embrace
DEVOUT-SHADOW_EMBRACE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage {Repeat:diff()} {Repeat:plural:time|times}.
[gold]Lifesteal[/gold] {Lifesteal:diff()} HP for each hit.
DEVOUT-SYZYGY.title: Syzygy
DEVOUT-SYZYGY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times, where X is the highest value.
If the other two values of X factor in, add them to the total.
DEVOUT-ORIGINAL_SIN.title: Original Sin
DEVOUT-ORIGINAL_SIN.description:
Increase [gold]Flagellant[/gold] by 1.
At the start of each turn, add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Whispering Shade{Cards:plural:|s}[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DEVOUT-WHISPERING_SHADE.title: Whispering Shade
DEVOUT-WHISPERING_SHADE.description:
At the end of your turn, if this
is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
While this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], [gold]Flagellant[/gold] is suppressed.
DEVOUT-SHIFT_WEIGHT.title: Shift Weight
DEVOUT-SHIFT_WEIGHT.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold]{IfUpgraded:show:, and {Buff:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn|}.
Whenever you [gold]Unsheathe[/gold], return this card from the [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DEVOUT-ANGEL_ENGINE.title: Angel Engine
DEVOUT-ANGEL_ENGINE.description:
At the start of your turn,
spend {AngelEnginePower:pietyIcons()} to gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
DEVOUT-TITANICUS.title: Titanicus
DEVOUT-NUMINOUS_AUREOLA.title: Numinous Aureola
DEVOUT-LITURGY.title: Liturgy
DEVOUT-BARE_FANGS.title: Bare Fangs
DEVOUT-INQUISITION.title: Inquisition
DEVOUT-INQUISITION.description:
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and add {Cards:diff()} {IfUpgraded:show:[purple]Soulflame[/purple] |}[gold]Burn{Cards:plural:|s}[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DEVOUT-PENANCE_STARE.title: Penance Stare
DEVOUT-PENANCE_STARE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Add {Cards:diff()} {IfUpgraded:show:[purple]Soulflame[/purple] |}[gold]Burn{Cards:plural:|s}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], [gold]Hand[/gold], and [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
DEVOUT-RAVENOUS_HUNGER.title: Ravenous Hunger
DEVOUT-RAVENOUS_HUNGER.description:
Whenever ANYONE dies, gain [gold]Ringing[/gold].
Next turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold], and [gold]Lifesteal[/gold] {Lifesteal:diff()} Max HP.
DEVOUT-THE_WORD.title: The Word
DEVOUT-WARDING_WORD.title: Warding Word
DEVOUT-WARDING_WORD.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply {CharmedPower:diff()} [gold]Charmed[/gold].
If the enemy was already [gold]Charmed[/gold], play this again.
DEVOUT-HYMN_OF_SANCTUARY.title: Hymn of Sanctuary
DEVOUT-HYMN_OF_SANCTUARY.description:
Apply {CharmedPower:diff()} [gold]Charm[/gold] to ALL enemies.
If ANY enemy was already [gold]Charmed[/gold], play this again.
DEVOUT-STRENGTH_THROUGH_PAIN.title: Strength From Pain
DEVOUT-CRACK_THE_SKY.title: Crack the Sky
DEVOUT-CRACK_THE_SKY.description:
Deal {Beam:diff()} damage to a random enemy X times.
Deals {Numerator:diff()} additional damage for every {Denominator:diff()} [purple]Soulflames[/purple] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
DEVOUT-FLAGELLANCE.title: Flagellance
DEVOUT-FLAGELLANCE.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
[gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:diff()} card{Cards:plural:|s} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] with [purple]Soulflame[/purple].
DEVOUT-RUMINATE.title: Ruminate
DEVOUT-RUMINATE.description:
Put {Cards:diff()} card{Cards:plural:|s} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
[gold]Enchant[/gold] {Cards:plural:that card|those cards} with [purple]Soulflame[/purple].
DEVOUT-RUMINATE.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose Cards to put on top of your Draw Pile
DEVOUT-SLASH.title: Slash
DEVOUT-SLASH.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} card{Cards:plural:|s}.
Put {PutBack:diff()} card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
DEVOUT-SLASH.selectionScreenPrompt: Choose Cards to put on top of your Draw Pile
DEVOUT-FATALITY.title: Fatality
DEVOUT-FATALITY.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the enemy is [gold]Stunned[/gold], deals triple damage.
DEVOUT-BULLSTOMP.title: Bullstomp
DEVOUT-BULLSTOMP.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Any overkill damage is dealt to ALL enemies.
DEVOUT-WRATH_GUARD.title: Wrath's Guard
DEVOUT-FOOL_GUARD.title: Fool's Guard
DEVOUT-DAM_GUARD.title: Dam's Guard
DEVOUT-DAM_GUARD.description:
{Unsheathe}.
Target an enemy.
Whenever you hit that enemy, apply {CharmedPower:diff()} [gold]Charm[/gold].
Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
DEVOUT-BOAR_GUARD.title: Boar's Guard
DEVOUT-BOAR_GUARD.description:
{Unsheathe}.
This turn, the first time you play {Angur}, apply {Primary:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
Thereafter, you gain {Secondary:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
DEVOUT-HEIFER_GUARD.title: Heifer's Guard
DEVOUT-HEIFER_GUARD.description:
{Unsheathe}.
This turn, the first time you play {Angur}, apply {Primary:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Thereafter, apply {Secondary:diff()} [gold]Charmed[/gold].
DEVOUT-TOWER_GUARD.title: Tower's Guard
DEVOUT-TOWER_GUARD.description:
{Unsheathe}.
This turn, the first time you play {Angur}, apply {Primary:diff()} [gold]Frail[/gold].
Thereafter, {Angur} gains {Secondary:diff()} [gold]Heavy[/gold].
DEVOUT-GATE_GUARD.title: Gate's Guard
DEVOUT-GATE_GUARD.description:
{Unsheathe} and grant it [gold]Retain[/gold] this turn.
Gain [gold]Ringing[/gold].
Next turn, gain {Primary:energyIcons()}.
DEVOUT-AEGIS.title: Aegis
DEVOUT-AEGIS.description:
While this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold],
heal {Heal:diff()} HP at the end of your turn.
Whenever you gain {singlePietyIcon},
gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
DEVOUT-DOMICILE.title: Domicile
DEVOUT-DOMICILE.description:
While this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold],
lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP at the end of your turn.
Whenever you gain {singlePenanceIcon},
deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
DEVOUT-BRAZEN_BULL.title: Brazen Bull
DEVOUT-BRAZEN_BULL.description:
Gain {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
Whenever you create, draw or play a [gold]Burn[/gold] or [purple]Soulflame[/purple], ALL enemies take damage equal to your [gold]Plating[/gold].
DEVOUT-HEARTHLIGHT.title: Hearthlight
DEVOUT-HEARTHLIGHT.description:
Whenever an [gold]Upgraded[/gold]
card enters your [gold]Hand[/gold],
heal {HearthlightPower:diff()} HP gain {HearthlightPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold]
this turn.
DEVOUT-DUALSLASH.title: Dualslash
DEVOUT-DUALSLASH.description: The next time you {Unsheathe}, it gains [gold]Replay[/gold] {Repeat:diff()}.
DEVOUT-BATTLELUST.title: Battlelust
DEVOUT-MOURNING.title: Mourning
DEVOUT-COLD_HEART.title: Cold Heart
DEVOUT-BRAVE_HEART.title: Brave Heart
DEVOUT-BROKEN_HEART.title: Broken Heart
DEVOUT-HEART_AND_SOUL.title: Heart and Soul
DEVOUT-HEART_AND_SOUL.description: Whenever you enter a [gold]Stance[/gold], increase its [gold]Power[/gold] by {Power:diff()}.
DEVOUT-GIGANTES.title: Gigantes
DEVOUT-GIGANTES.description:
When you {Unsheathe}, you deal more and receive less damage from enemies that turn.
The modifier equals {DamageBase}%, plus {DamageAddition}% for each additional play.
DEVOUT-FLEX.title: Flex
DEVOUT-FLEX.description:
If in [gold]Cliodna[/gold], gain
{StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
Gain {FrailPower:diff()} [gold]Frail[/gold].
DEVOUT-RAGING_FLAME.title: Raging Flame
DEVOUT-SCYTHING_DANCE.title: Scything Dance
DEVOUT-SCYTHING_DANCE.description:
Must be in [gold]Cliodna[/gold].
When you play a card, deal {Power:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
DEVOUT-BINDING_DANCE.title: Binding Dance
DEVOUT-BINDING_DANCE.description:
Must be in [gold]Cliodna[/gold].
When you play a card, apply {Power:diff()} [gold]Braidbound[/gold] to the enemy.
DEVOUT-DANCE_OF_DEATH.title: Dance of Death
DEVOUT-DANCE_OF_DEATH.description:
Enter [gold]Cliodna[/gold].
When you play a card, gain {Power:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
DEVOUT-LIMIT_BREAK.title: Limit Break
DEVOUT-RIGHTEOUS_REVELRY.title: Righteous Revelry
DEVOUT-RIGHTEOUS_REVELRY.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Gain {StrengthSelf:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
ALL enemies gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
Enter [gold]Cliodna[/gold].
DEVOUT-SUMMER_QUEEN.title: Summer Queen
DEVOUT-SUMMER_QUEEN.description:
Must be in [gold]Cliodna[/gold].
Heal {Heal:diff()} HP.
Gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] for every [purple]Soulflame[/purple] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
DEVOUT-LILT.title: Lilt
DEVOUT-LILT.description:
If in [gold]Caoineag[/gold], gain
{DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
Gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
DEVOUT-WEAVING_WAVES.title: Weaving Waves
DEVOUT-HAUNTING_MELODY.title: Haunting Melody
DEVOUT-HAUNTING_MELODY.description:
Must be in [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
When you play a card,
gain {Power:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
DEVOUT-DIRGING_SONG.title: Dirging Song
DEVOUT-DIRGING_SONG.description:
Must be in [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
When you play a card, apply {Power:diff()} [gold]Charm[/gold] to ALL enemies.
DEVOUT-MILK_OF_CREATION.title: Milk of Creation
DEVOUT-MILK_OF_CREATION.description:
Enter [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
When you play a card, heal {Power:diff()} HP.
If that card is a [purple]Soulflame[/purple], it does not damage you.
DEVOUT-VEIL_OF_SHADOWS.title: Veil of Shadows
DEVOUT-VEIL_OF_SHADOWS.description:
[gold]Flip[/gold] to [blue]Screams[/blue].
Must be in [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
When you are attacked, [gold]Lifesteal[/gold] {Effect:diff()} HP.
DEVOUT-VEIL_OF_SONG.title: Veil of Song
DEVOUT-VEIL_OF_SONG.description:
[gold]Flip[/gold] to [blue]Shadows[/blue].
Must be in [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
When you are attacked, apply {Effect:diff()} [gold]Charm[/gold] to the attacker.
DEVOUT-VEIL_OF_SCREAMS.title: Veil of Screams
DEVOUT-VEIL_OF_SCREAMS.description:
[gold]Flip[/gold] to [blue]Song[/blue].
Must be in [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
When you are attacked, increase its [gold]Thorns[/gold] by {Effect:diff()}.
DEVOUT-THE_WEEPING.title: The Weeping
DEVOUT-THE_WEEPING.description:
Lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
Gain {WeakSelf:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
Enter [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
DEVOUT-WINTER_WAIL.title: Winter's Wail
DEVOUT-WINTER_WAIL.description:
Must be in [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
[gold]Stun[/gold] ALL enemies.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies for every [purple]Soulflame[/purple] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
DEVOUT-BASIC_BITE.title: Bite
DEVOUT-BASIC_BITE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the damage was unblocked, increase the damage of ALL Bite cards by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
DEVOUT-SANGUINE_BITE.title: Sanguine Bite
DEVOUT-SANGUINE_BITE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the damage was unblocked, [gold]Lifesteal[/gold] {Rider:diff()} HP, or {RiderPlus} if the target is [gold]Charmed[/gold].
DEVOUT-CRUSHING_BITE.title: Crushing Bite
DEVOUT-CRUSHING_BITE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the damage was unblocked, the target loses {Rider:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold], or {RiderPlus} if they are [gold]Charmed[/gold].
DEVOUT-BITING_FEAST.title: Biting Feast
DEVOUT-BITING_FEAST.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Hits 1 time for each Bite card in your deck.
For each fully unblocked hit, [gold]Lifesteal[/gold] {Rider:diff()} HP, or {RiderPlus} if the target is [gold]Charmed[/gold].
DEVOUT-DEVOUR.title: Devour
DEVOUT-DEVOUR.description:
Deal {CalculationBase:diff()} damage, plus the
damage gained by ALL Bite
cards this combat.{IsTargeting:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
If this kills the target,
gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
DEVOUT-SALIVATE.title: Salivate
DEVOUT-SALIVATE.description:
Pull ALL Bite cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
Reduce their cost by {Energy:diff()} for this turn.|}
DEVOUT-BASIC_BRAID.title: Striking Braid
DEVOUT-COILING_BRAID.title: Coiling Braid
DEVOUT-SQUEEZING_BRAID.title: Squeezing Braid
DEVOUT-SQUEEZING_BRAID.description:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each [gold]Braidbound[/gold] on the enemy.
DEVOUT-BASHING_BRAID.title: Bashing Braid
DEVOUT-BASHING_BRAID.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If the target has {Threshold} or more [gold]Braidbound[/gold], hits twice.
DEVOUT-BRAIDCRUSH.title: Braidcrush
DEVOUT-BRAIDCRUSH.description:
Must be in [gold]Cliodna[/gold].
Apply {ConstrictPower:diff()} [gold]Braidbound[/gold].
Gain {StrengthPerConstrict:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] for each [gold]Braidbound[/gold] on the enemy.
DEVOUT-BOILING_BRAID.title: Boiling Braid
DEVOUT-BOILING_BRAID.description: Whenever you create, draw or play a [purple]Soulflame[/purple], ALL [gold]Braidbound[/gold] enemies take {IfUpgraded:show:triple|double} its damage.
DEVOUT-ROSARY_WRATH.title: Rosary's Wrath
DEVOUT-ROSARY_WRATH.description:
Double the enemy's [gold]Braidbound[/gold].
Trigger its effect.
DEVOUT-WEAVE.title: Weave
DEVOUT-WEAVE.description:
Pull ALL Braid cards from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].{IfUpgraded:show:
Reduce their cost by {Energy:diff()} for this turn.|}
DEVOUT-RAPUNZEL.title: Rapunzel
DEVOUT-RAPUNZEL.description: When you play {Angur} with at least {Threshold:diff()} [gold]Heavy[/gold], double the [gold]Braidbound[/gold] on ALL enemies{IfUpgraded:show: and immediately activate its effects|}.
DEVOUT-ECLIPSE.title: Eclipse
DEVOUT-ECLIPSE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times, where X is the highest value.
If both values of X are equal, add them together.
DEVOUT-YGGDRASIL.title: Yggdrasil
DEVOUT-YGGDRASIL.description:
When you gain {singlePietyIcon},
lose HP equal to the HP
gained, draw {Cards:diff()} card{Cards:plural:|s},
and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
DEVOUT-IDDRASIL.title: Iddrasil
DEVOUT-KINDER_DAYS.title: Kinder Days
DEVOUT-KINDER_DAYS.description: At the start of each turn, play, and then [purple]Snuff[/purple], a random [purple]Soulflame[/purple] card from your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
DEVOUT-GLAISTIG.title: Glaistig
DEVOUT-GLAISTIG.description:
{IfUpgraded:show:Gain {DexterityPower:diff()} [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
|}Whenever you play a [gold]Rhythmic[/gold] card, play it again.
DEVOUT-SOULFLAME_MAIDEN.title: Soulflame Maiden
DEVOUT-SOULFLAME_MAIDEN.description:
Apply {PlatingPower:diff()} [gold]Plating[/gold].
The enemy loses [gold]Strength[/gold] equal to their [gold]Plating[/gold], and at the end of each turn, the enemy loses {Numerator:diff()} HP for every {Denominator:diff()} [purple]Soulflames[/purple] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold].
DEVOUT-SWORDS_OF_SEALING_LIGHT.title: Swords of Sealing Light
DEVOUT-SWORDS_OF_SEALING_LIGHT.descripti: Whenever you {Unsheathe} for a [purple]Technique[/purple], ALL enemies gain {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold].
DEVOUT-ARMOUR_OF_GOD.title: Armour of God
DEVOUT-ARMOUR_OF_GOD.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Blocked attack damage is reflected to your attacker threefold this turn.
At the start of your next turn, gain {VulnerablePower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
DEVOUT-APOCALYPSE.title: Apocalypse
DEVOUT-APOCALYPSE.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times.
Next turn, put X/{Cards:diff()} cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
DEVOUT-PANDEMONIUM.title: Pandemonium
DEVOUT-PANDEMONIUM.description:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies X times.
[gold]Lifesteal[/gold] {Lifesteal:diff()} HP X times.
DEVOUT-MARTYRDOM.title: Martyrdom
DEVOUT-FADE_AWAY.title: Fade Away
DEVOUT-FADE_AWAY.description:
Must be in [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
Every turn you remain in [gold]Caoineag[/gold], gain {IntangiblePower:diff()} [gold]Intangible[/gold], and lose {HpLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] and [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
DEVOUT-SACRED_HEART.title: Sacred Heart
DEVOUT-HEART_OF_DARKNESS.title: Heart of Darkness
DEVOUT-HEART_OF_DARKNESS.description:
On [gold]Flip[/gold], costs +1{Energy:energyIcons()}.
At the end of your turn,
if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold],
EVERYONE loses {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
DEVOUT-FALLEN_ANGEL.title: Fallen Angel
DEVOUT-FALLEN_ANGEL.description:
Begin [gold]Ascending[/gold] {Wings:diff()}.
When you are [gold]Knocked Down[/gold],
enchant ALL Cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] with [purple]Soulflame[/purple], and deal {Power:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
DEVOUT-SERAPH_FORM.title: Seraph Form
DEVOUT-SERAPH_FORM.description:
At the start of your turn,
begin [gold]Ascending[/gold] {Wings:diff()}.
When you are [gold]Knocked Down[/gold],
enchant {Cards:diff()} random card{Cards:plural:|s} in your
[gold]Hand[/gold] with [purple]Soulflame[/purple].
DEVOUT-SUCCUBUS_FORM.title: Succubus Form
DEVOUT-SUCCUBUS_FORM.description:
Whenever you hit, [gold]Charm[/gold] or [gold]Lifesteal[/gold] an enemy, apply {BraidboundPower:diff()} [gold]Braidbound[/gold].
When [gold]Braidbound[/gold] causes a [gold]Stun[/gold],
[gold]Lifesteal[/gold] {Lifesteal:diff()} HP.
DEVOUT-REFLECTIONS.title: Reflections
DEVOUT-REFLECTIONS.description:
Choose an ally.
Whenever you enter a [gold]Stance[/gold],
they enter the opposite one to you.
DEVOUT-FIGHTING_SPIRIT.title: Fighting Spirit
DEVOUT-FIGHTING_SPIRIT.description: Whenever another player gains [gold]Strength[/gold], you gain half that [gold]Strength[/gold].
DEVOUT-AURA_OF_HOPE.title: Aura of Hope
DEVOUT-AURA_OF_HOPE.description: Whenever you gain HP on your turn, other players gain {Heal:diff()} HP.
DEVOUT-MOURNFUL_WAIL.title: Mournful Wail
DEVOUT-MOURNFUL_WAIL.description:
Must be in [gold]Caoineag[/gold].
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Whenever an ally dies, if this is in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold], play it, hitting 1 additional time for every {Threshold:diff()} Max HP that ally had.
DEVOUT-BRILLIANT_SMILE.title: Brilliant Smile
DEVOUT-BRILLIANT_SMILE.description:
Must be in [gold]Cliodna[/gold].
Gain {Heal:diff()} HP.
EVERYONE regains HP equal to HALF your current [gold]Strength[/gold].
